education.title: B.E. in Computer Science
education.body:
CGPA: 9.83/10. Director’s Gold Medal; full tuition waiver through the Institute Merit Scholarship for consistently ranking in the top 1%.
Coursework: Data Structures and Algorithms, Object Oriented Programming, Database Systems, Theory of Computation, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Linear Algebra, Vector Calculus, Probability and Statistics, Discrete Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Graphics, and Human Computer Interaction.

experience.title: Research Assistant
experience.place: ETH SCAI Lab · Zürich / Nottwil, Switzerland
experience.body: Analyzing multimodal wearable and clinical data for decongestion monitoring in cardiac recovery.

experience.title: Research Intern
experience.body: Developed a psychologically grounded, dynamic state-aware framework for simulating diverse and evolving student behaviours beyond static personas, enabling evaluation of adaptive LLM tutors across multi-turn interactions. This work led to DySAS, accepted at REALM @ EMNLP 2026.

experience.title: Research Fellow
experience.body: Developed a privacy taxonomy and curated a dataset for context-dependent, privacy-preserving summarization. Evaluated LLMs using automatic metrics and human judgments, improving privacy adherence over GPT-4o while maintaining summary consistency, relevance, and coherence.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
experience.body: Resolved memory leaks with memlab, reducing memory consumption by over 10%. Implemented server-side rendering with Next.js and GraphQL and end-to-end tests, improving load times by over 20%. Identified render blockers and improved application performance and resilience.

experience.title: Research Intern
experience.body: Built a fundus-image annotation tool covering soft and hard exudates, microaneurysms, hemorrhages, and neovascularization. Collaborated with a hospital to curate a 3,000-image dataset. Applied image processing and custom deep-learning models to automate lesion annotation, achieving over 80% accuracy and specificity.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
experience.body: Built an end-to-end application using React.js, GraphQL, and Go to manage credit types for over 2,000 employees. Migrated financial data to a centralized MySQL database and automated integration and end-to-end tests, reducing onboarding time by two months.

experience.title: Research Intern
experience.body: Trained customized variational autoencoders for parameter-controlled vehicle-component design generation on a proprietary dataset of over 25,000 data points. Developed comparison heuristics and a web application for researchers to generate custom designs.

experience.title: Summer Research Intern
experience.body: Built keyword-based image collection and annotation workflows and an automated bounding-box dataset pipeline. Trained a customized YOLOv7 model on public and proprietary datasets to distinguish people from objects and barriers; successful detections achieved over 90% model confidence.

teaching.title: AI and Digital Technology
teaching.body: Developed AI analytics initiatives for executive education, including privacy-preserving machine learning and synthetic-data projects.

teaching.title: Techniques in Social Research
teaching.body: Introduced foundational research methodologies and supported the analysis of social research projects.

teaching.title: Microprocessors and Interfacing
teaching.body: Conducted laboratory sessions on MASM-based assembly programming and guided hands-on interfacing exercises.

projects.title: NeuroReach VR
projects.body: Built a pass-through mixed-reality system on Meta Quest 3S with Logitech MX Ink for gross- and fine-motor training. Added clinician-readable event-level CSV logging. A 10-user pilot achieved a System Usability Scale score of 79.7/100.

projects.title: Systemic Diabetic Retinopathy Analysis
projects.body: Developed a portal for studying systemic factors in diabetic retinopathy. Compared TabNet and DeepForests on tabular data across hospitals in India and Hong Kong, achieving over 80% model-testing accuracy.

projects.title: Dynamic Third-Person Shooter
projects.body: Built a 3D open-world game in C# with missions, day–night cycles, and an inventory system. Integrated Blender assets, Unity animations, and Cinemachine camera controls.

projects.title: Text-Based Fake News Classification
projects.body: Compared LSTM, Bi-LSTM, and ensemble classifiers for online misinformation detection, achieving over 90% across the reported evaluation metrics. The resulting IBICA 2022 paper was published by Springer in 2023.

awards.title: ASIA 2026 Data Challenge · Track 2 Winner
awards.body: Won the longitudinal ISNCSCI imputation track, reconstructing full neurological sensory examinations from expedited assessments and baseline examinations. Built a leakage-safe pipeline with target-wise TabPFNv2.5 bagging, copy-through, symmetry, modality, and anchor post-processing.

awards.title: Institute Merit Scholarship
awards.body: Full tuition waiver for consistently ranking in the top 1% of the institute.

awards.title: Machine Learning Summer School
awards.body: Selected for and completed an integrated machine-learning training programme with Amazon experts.

community.title: Publicity Coordinator · Arunodoi
community.body: Led photo- and video-editing teams to promote Northeast India’s cultural awareness and community engagement.

community.title: Volunteer · Indian Red Cross Society
